run_save_features_cli: run the save_features CLI to extract ResNet features from a dataset and save them to an HDF5 file
run_save_features_with_model: run the save_features script with a custom model file, config YAML, and output path to cache features
create_save_features_function: create a function that extracts features from a PyTorch model across a data loader and writes them to an HDF5 file
create_get_model_function: create a function that instantiates a ResNet model (ResNet10, 18, 34, 50, or 101) given a model name and number of classes
review_save_features_workflow: review the save_features workflow that loads a model checkpoint, runs inference on a dataset, and saves features and labels to HDF5
